flagship_project.name: Project Gigafactory Core: Autonomous Edge Telemetry, 4680 Solid-State Cell Thermal Optimizer & Fleet Autopilot Mesh
flagship_project.pillar: Industrial IoT Digital Twin, Battery Management System (BMS) Telemetry & Edge Autopilot
flagship_project.strategic_thesis: Ola Electric's core moat is vertical integration from indigenous battery cell chemistry to connected vehicles. Gigafactory Core streams 1,000+ real-time telemetry parameters per vehicle back to an edge-cloud digital twin, dynamically adapting BMS thermal envelopes, preventing battery degradation, and automating OTA firmware safely.
flagship_project.tech_stack: C/C++ (Embedded RTOS on Vehicle ECU), Rust (Edge Gateway), Apache Kafka / EMQX (Millions of MQTT IoT Conns), TimescaleDB / ClickHouse (Time-Series Sensor Telemetry), TensorFlow Lite (Edge Battery Health Model), Kubernetes Edge
flagship_project.kpis: Predicts thermal anomalies 48 hours prior to cell degradation; extends battery lifecycle by 35%; processes 10B daily telemetry points across 500,000+ active EVs.
